description: A shell script for testing gitweb as a standalone CGI script, performing various tests on git repository states, commits, diffs, tags, logs, and configurations. It automates running gitweb with different parameters and checks outputs for correctness.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function to run the gitweb script with specified parameters and capture output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function to define a test case expecting success with a description and command.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Function to check for prerequisites before running certain tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Function to register commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Function to set or check configuration for tests.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Function to attempt a command that might fail without failing the test.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Function to create symbolic links and add them to git.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Function to change file permissions for testing.
